name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Jared Huffman with large cash advantage
model.rationale: Huffman is a well-funded incumbent in a D+13 district with no polls, ratings, or spending suggesting vulnerability, and prediction markets price his reelection near certain. The forecast stays at a wide Democratic margin consistent with fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or unusually low-turnout top-two general could narrow the margin, though not plausibly the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: North Coast incumbent Jared Huffman seeks another term in a district that leans Democratic by about thirteen points. He enters the general with over a million dollars on hand and no meaningful outside opposition, while Republican Robin Littau has reported little or no fundraising and no outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Huffman roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. The top-two primary advanced Huffman to the general, and the seat has been safely Democratic throughout his tenure. With a strong partisan lean, incumbency, and a large financial edge all pointing the same direction, this race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
